label: GO WITH CONDITIONS
recommendation: Launch B behind a three-week paid gate: sell a EUR 49 tested-decision report by hand to 20 founders, then open a public German page with the report as the front door.
conditions: Production works and one council session costs EUR 1.50 or less, measured by 2026-11-15
Gate by 2026-12-06: at least 8 of 20 pay EUR 49, refunds at most 25%, at least 5 share unprompted
Platform cap = max(EUR 50, 20% of last month's revenue), trial reserve separate, before any public link
Three councils visible, ten hidden; founder hours at most 10 a week
next_steps: By 2026-11-08: production live, 10 real sessions logged
By 2026-11-15: 20 named founders, EUR 49 checkout, revenue-linked cap
cheapest_test: 20 hand-sold EUR 49 reports to founders with a real decision.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 6 of 20 pay or fewer than 4 share at the gate; under 40 paying buyers by day 90.
